name: SignalBridge synthetic analyst review handoff

steps.purpose: An authenticated SignalBridge dispatcher executes one fixed private Shuffle workflow with the validated metadata envelope.
One allowlisted integration action re-resolves the original event and current case version inside a disposable SignalBridge instance; stale or cross-scope evidence fails.
The same scoped receiver transactionally creates at most one analyst review task or returns its existing receipt; no source-app mutation occurs.
Record the genuine Shuffle execution ID and task ID with input, workflow and receipt hashes, then stop; an analyst makes any investigation decision separately.

forbidden: automatic retries after an unknown side effect
implementation_gaps: scoped SignalBridge receiver and task model
imported native Shuffle workflow with actual installation-specific action IDs
